hooks.text: 零食既是会升级的弹幕武器，也能被露米娅吃掉以获得永久强化和被动攻击。
hooks.excerpt: All the different snacks have different upsides and downsides, and will level up and grow stronger as you battle with them! Rumia can also eat snacks to grow stronger permanently, additionally gaining that snack as a passive attack!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 百余件道具涵盖属性提升、挡弹伙伴和复制效果，并强调与现有道具及零食联动。
hooks.excerpt: There are items that simply raise your stats, ones that summon battle partners that block bullets, and even ones that treat other items like you have two of them...!? There's a whole variety pack of items to choose from, but don't forget to pick ones that synergize with your other items... and your snacks too, of course!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: “饼干硬度”允许随时调高或调低难度，胜利后还会逐步解锁更高挑战。
hooks.excerpt: Change the game's Biscuit Hardness to make things easier or harder! You'll unlock harder and harder difficulties as you keep winning runs. But don't worry — you can always make things easier if you feel like the game is too difficult!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
